title: Prison of Anemas
geometryBasis: Mapped wall offsets, the projecting 28 m twin-tower front, and the surveyed 14-compartment retaining range on the Blachernae terrace.
sectionBasis: The Edson plan and 1899 survey give the lengths, north and south tower envelopes, wall height and gallery spacing. Exterior plates show rocky crowns, bands of brickwork, projecting columns, buttresses and tall openings.
limitations: The model represents the standing paired towers and the adjacent Blachernae retaining range, with approximated climbing masonry and chamber roofs.

The geometry combines the original surveyed plan, mapped wall, historical exterior plates and available site terrain. Fine stone profiles, tower crown breaks, exact restoration fabric and the vertical registration of the terrace remain approximate.
The original height field is preserved. Temporary restoration equipment, the neighbouring mosque, and unrelated lengths of the city walls are outside the modeled site.
